Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Antonio Leonviola died in Rovigo and attributed this to IMDb and Wikipedia without verifying the underlying pages. This misinterpretation of search snippets (and mis-citation of Wikipedia) set the trajectory toward the wrong death place, despite later evidence indicating the correct location is Rome (Roma).
